'''Toobu''' was a large and powerful [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who acquired the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tivva]] as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]].
